name: Mercado Porto Belo
description: Inspired by London's famous market, this charming Saturday spot offers a mix of vinyl, vintage items, and handmade crafts alongside delicious organic products.
longDescription:
Mercado Porto Belo is an outdoor market held in Praça de Carlos Alberto, inspired by similar markets found in London. It brings together a selection of vendors offering a range of goods, including vinyl records, vintage clothing and accessories, handcrafted items, and organic food products. The market aims to provide a regular gathering point for local artisans, collectors, and producers.

Visitors can browse the various stalls, which are set up in the open air of the square. The atmosphere is generally relaxed, with a focus on discovery and interaction with vendors. The market is suitable for a general audience and offers an opportunity to explore a diverse array of goods in a central Porto location.

Entry to Mercado Porto Belo is free of charge, and no tickets are required. The market is easily accessible, located a short walk from Trindade metro station. Praça de Carlos Alberto is also served by several bus routes.
